flags.item: The scheduled refresh stopped on 2026-10-25 because three test fixtures hardcoded a date that crossed the 24 h receipt window [verified 2026-10-25 against the failing job's step list, data/build_failed_steps.txt and data/diag/failure-2026-10-25T1134Z.log]
flags.detail: Run 40189452274 (2026-10-25T11:34Z) failed at 'Stop on failed gate' with data/build_failed_steps.txt = unit-tests. The publish gate itself was green: tools/verify.py passed all 48 checks in that same run. The failing stage was the unit tests: tests/test_corroborate_history.py and tests/test_corroborate_offlist.py build receipt fixtures with a hardcoded captured_utc of 2026-10-24T00:00Z, and tools/corroborate.py measures a capture against the wall clock (RECEIPT_MAX_AGE_HOURS = 24). Once that literal aged past 24 h the receipts were classified 'expired' instead of 'usable' and three assertions inverted, so every scheduled run after ~2026-10-25T00:00Z would fail until the calendar moved. Fixed by generating the fixtures relative to now; the assertions are unchanged, so a real classification bug still fails the suite. The failing log is archived at data/diag/failure-2026-10-25T1134Z.log, and a green run now clears data/build_failed_steps.txt. Consequence to note for review: the published snapshot is 2026-10-24T20:54Z, i.e. older than one 6 h cycle, until the next green refresh publishes.
flags.verification: verified 2026-10-25 against the failing job's step list, data/build_failed_steps.txt and data/diag/failure-2026-10-25T1134Z.log

flags.item: The six-hourly refresh failed for 24 hours because receipts for delisted fixtures were counted as rejected [verified 2026-10-24 against the failing run's own log and the green run after the fix]
flags.detail: Hotspawn's fixtures API only returns cards with status=scheduled and drops a card once it kicks off, so a static external-odds receipt points at a fixture that is no longer listed within a day. tools/corroborate.py classified those as 'unmatched / rejected', and the publish gate 'external receipts validated against the dataset' fails whenever any receipt is rejected. Every scheduled refresh from 2026-10-23T17:13Z to 2026-10-24T16:19Z therefore failed at the gate (40 of 41 checks passing) and the published site stayed frozen at the 2026-10-23T17:13:12Z snapshot. Fixed in PR #62: such a receipt is now classified as historical evidence, kept and dated on the coverage page, excluded from every price and from the gate, which still fails on malformed receipts and on receipts that name the wrong teams for a fixture we do list. The first green run after the fix is 40110996859 (2026-10-24T16:19Z, 241/241 fixtures, 41/41 gates, 16 historical receipts).
flags.verification: verified 2026-10-24 against the failing run's own log and the green run after the fix
